  "root_cause": "session_id is forwarded as a top-level API parameter to the model provider. OpenAI's API rejects it because session_id is not part of OpenAI's request schema.   "patch": "Strip session_id from outgoing provider requests unconditionally. Handle tape session continuity entirely on the Eli side: persist session_id in the local tape store and use it only for tape lookups internally.
